title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Completed annual load forecast and reliability-oriented commentary using 15-min load data. Implemented reproducible pipeline in code/run_analysis.py, generated cleaned metrics, calendar-only daily regression forecast with bootstrap uncertainty, backtest/fit plots, and reliability/ramp analyses. Saved figures to report/images (fig1–fig7), outputs tables to outputs/, and wrote publication-style report to report/report.md.
